sloka: इति संचिन्त्य मनसा छायामस्य समाक्षिपत् ।छायायां गृह्यमाणायां चिन्तयामास वानरः ॥५-१-१८४॥
transliteration: iti saṁcintya manasā chāyāmasya samākṣipat ।chāyāyāṁ gṛhyamāṇāyāṁ cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ ॥5-1-184॥

translations.english: Thinking thus, she dragged him by his shadow before she took hold of him, Hanuman started deliberating within.
